messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty auto-page fired: PD-20347 - "canary-5xx-rate > 5% for model-embed-qa - deployment/rollout=release-2026-03-15". Auto-created by monitor-canary-telemetry. Link: <https://pagerduty.local/PD-20347>

pagerduty: Incident created PD-20347 · Urgency: high · Escalation: oncall-sre · Acknowledge window: 5m

maya: acked PD-20347 :hand: I'm oncall, taking initial triage.

maya: quick synopsis: p95 and 5xx spike observed on canary fleet (us-west-2). Canary fraction for release-2026-03-15 was ramping. Noticed error traces referencing kv-cache.

kevin: I pushed a tokenizer/kv-cache tweak with release-2026-03-15 last night. Rolling tests looked green but didn't run the model variant used by embed-qa.

raj: @maya thanks. Can you confirm customer impact?

maya: prelim: internal synthetic canaries failing, and two customer tenants show elevated errors — acme-corp ~12%, brightchat ~9%. No full-account outages reported yet.

maya: sample log snippet:
```json
{"error":"ModelExecutionError","message":"kv-cache miss panic at step 12","pod":"embed-canary-7","req_id":"req-8a3f"}
```

alice: tagging runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/canary-failures — follow section "Immediate rollbacks and traffic holds"

maya: I put a temporary traffic hold on the canary via the release proxy: `rproxy block release-2026-03-15 --fraction 0.0 --scope canary --region us-west-2` (executed).

maya: CLI output: ```OK blocked release-2026-03-15 on us-west-2 canaries```

pagerduty: PD-20347 acknowledged by maya at 3112223380

kevin: can we patch or should we rollback the canary? Patch would be faster but risky without proper test on the variant.

raj: recommend rollback for canary group to be safe. I'll lead rollback and monitoring.

raj: rollback command (started):
```bash
deploy rollback --release release-2026-03-15 --to release-2026-03-14 --target canary --region us-west-2
```

raj: rollback initiated at 3112223420 — monitoring pods and healthchecks now.

maya: confirmed traffic diversion working; canary error rate down to ~1.2% (synthetic and customer traces improving) as of a few mins ago.

kevin: post-rollback logs look clean on previously failing pod embed-canary-7:
```
[03/15 14:12:45] embed-canary-7 INFO request=req-8a3f completed status=200
```

maya: support notified affected customers per runbook (acme-corp, brightchat). Support will follow up with mitigation notes and ETA.

alice: assigning postmortem owner: kevin (release owner). Please cover RCA, why regression passed presubmit, and recommend gating (e.g., variant test matrix).

maya: handing monitoring to day SRE @raj for the next 4 hours. I'll clear the active PD page after we confirm stability.

pagerduty: PD-20347 resolved by maya at 3112223810 :white_check_mark:

raj: closing coordination here. I'll keep checking the canary cohort until 3112224410 and re-open if metrics regress.

maya: thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: add kv-cache stress scenario to CI, and reduce default canary ramp from 10% to 2% for model-embedding releases.

kevin: noted. I'll draft the postmortem and include action items. :thumbsup:
